sections.heading: How your free website preview works

steps.title: Tell us about your business
steps.body: Share your business name, website and a few basic details. We’ll review your current online presence and identify the best way to create a useful preview.

steps.title: We build your private preview
steps.body: We use your real business information, services, branding and publicly available content to create a private website preview tailored to your business.
steps.note: No payment is required to review it.

steps.title: Review it privately for 7 days
steps.body: Explore your preview on a private link for seven days. It isn’t public, and your existing website stays unchanged while you review the new version.

steps.title: Choose a plan or simply walk away
steps.body: If you like the preview, choose a monthly plan and we’ll complete, launch and manage the website for you. If it isn’t right for you, the preview expires — with no obligation.

large.title: Everything handled
large.body: Hosting, security, backups, routine updates, monitoring and technical support are all included — so you have one team responsible for keeping your website running smoothly.

items.title: Hosting, security & backups
items.body: Fast managed hosting, SSL security, uptime monitoring and regular backups are included with every active plan.

items.title: Performance & analytics
items.body: Track website traffic, visitor activity and enquiry performance so you can see how your website is working for your business.

items.title: Routine content updates
items.body: Need to change text, photos, business hours, services or other everyday content? Routine updates are included within your plan.

items.title: SEO-ready foundation
items.body: Every website is built with clean structure, search-friendly content, metadata and technical foundations designed to help search engines understand your business.

items.title: Mobile-first experience
items.body: Your website is designed to load, read and convert smoothly across phones, tablets and desktops — where many local customers search and call from.
